# 4.0
[Report Bug](https://github.com/KAMKEEL/MorePlayerModels-Plus/issues)

## MPM+
☑️ **Mod Rewrite**
> A large portion of the mod has been rewritten to handle packets differently between the Server and Client. Less skin flickering. Better skin caching! More accurate animation handling, FOV positioning. 

☑️ **Data Handling**
> Data is now fully server side. Presets are local, no longer in one individual file. This prevents Preset Deletion. Configs can be made to prevent presets from being loaded and saved from the server too.

☑️ **Permission Overhaul**
> An entirely built from the roundup Permission System for better syncing, and default configs for the server side. Better command management!

☑️ **Size Command**
> Added a /setsize Command for modifying the visual size of players. Currently a little buggy, but its similar to CustomNPC+ Sizing.

☑️ **Backported Animations**
> 3 New Animations have been added! Death, Yes, and No!

☑️ **Other**
- Removed useless refresh variables for more efficient client side handling
- Used Player Names for sending Packet Information and UUID for Saving to the Server Side
- Revamped Save Directory formatting (You may need to move your existing data / presets)

⚙️ **Fixes** 
- Fix Imgur Links redirecting and returning steve / blank skins
- Fix Sitting Animation not syncing when teleporting
- Fix skin flickering when constant teleportation (now returns cached image)
- Fix wrong texture showing during error, Steve64 and Alex Textures Added
- Capes no longer flicker
- Permission Racing, permissions now load instantly to the client when logging in
- Fixed Floating Sitting (Error known with Galactic Craft persists)
- Fixed Bow Animation desyncing Headwear
- Cache now properly clears upon reconnecting.

# 2.0 (Full Release)
[Report Bug](https://github.com/KAMKEEL/MorePlayerModels-Plus/issues)

## MPM+
☑️ **Fresh GUI**
> For those who have played MorePlayerModels 1.8 through 1.11, may find the backported GUI very familiar! I have managed to recreate and backport majority of the functionality from the later versions to make managing parts, data and configs much easier! 

☑️ **Minecraft Profile Skin** on **ALL Models** (Steve, Alex, Steve64)
> Now your DEFAULT Minecraft Skin should be supported on ALL Models! 

☑️ **Capes**
> I have decided to ADD Cape integration into MPM+! Now you can either enter a local directory texture path or URL to an image file for your capes! Do note, if you have OPTIFINE capes or other CAPES mods you may want to disable their CAPES in the video settings if you wish to use MPM+ Capes

☑️ **Model Saving Format**
> With the NEW Gui and better playerdata saving functionality. Your previous MPM+ Model Data or Presets may NOT be initialized correctly. It should be a quick move however to port your data with our new GUI! 
_*Majority of Presets or Settings will Port just fine and no corruption occur if it doesn't_

⚙️ **Fixes** 
> Fixed Parts like Naga Legs, Digit, and Claws not generating properly on the player
> Syncing Player Models and Skins
> Syncing Animations
> Fixed Open GL related Crashes or Null Pointers with Model Types
> Fixed Wings Flapping Animation when standing still
> Optimized Saving PlayerData Calls to Reduce Lag

**Quick Fix*
- Fix Log in Reloading Skins issue
